capabilities: Publish a vault folder as a wiki or digital garden site via right-click
Configure site chrome, theme, and domain in a sidebar view
Sign in or claim a site to make it permanent instead of a 7-day rolling guest TTL
extras: Freemium: guest publishing is limited to 100 MB with a 7-day rolling content TTL; a signed-in free plan gives 200 MB and a permanent site with ~180-day idle archive. The manifest warns the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README is mostly quick-start, plan, and developer info; full docs live on external website/help/Discord links.
problem: Publishing a set of notes as a public site normally requires Git-based pipelines, a paid publishing service, or manual site setup.

relations.evidence: Single-note public links live in MDFriday Share.

summary: Folder-to-site publisher that turns a vault folder into a hosted wiki or digital garden without Git, an account, or setup.
